top_stories.title: Microsoft Says Attackers Exploited an Entra Connect Health Flaw and Read Tenant Metadata. Here's What to Ask Your Provider.
top_stories.summary: Microsoft disclosed that attackers exploited a vulnerability in Entra Connect Health, allowing them to read tenant metadata and administrator email addresses. The flaw did not expose passwords or tokens, but the incident involves a core Microsoft Entra (Azure AD) hybrid identity monitoring component used widely across enterprise environments.

top_stories.title: In 2027, “the agent did it” stops being an excuse
top_stories.summary: SailPoint's 2027 Identity Security Predictions report highlights a critical gap in AI agent governance, finding that 79% of enterprises have deployed AI agents in production while only 2% have implemented identity security controls for them. The report predicts growing pressure from regulators, boards, and insurers to establish accountability frameworks for autonomous AI agents, specifically around access privilege management and automated decision governance.

top_stories.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach
top_stories.summary: 1Password disclosed a security breach in which an attacker gained unauthorized access to some backend systems and customer information via a GitHub account compromise. Customer password vaults and secrets were reported as unaffected, though some customer data and source code were stolen.

top_stories.title: Okta Links ShinyHunters-Associated Vishing Group to New INCEPTION Data Leak Site
top_stories.summary: Okta's Threat Intelligence team has linked a threat cluster (O-UNC-053), previously affiliated with the ShinyHunters extortion group, to a rebranded operation now called INCEPTION. The group uses vishing attacks to steal credentials and gain unauthorized access, with Okta's team identifying connections between this cluster and a new data leak site.

top_stories.title: Attacker used 1Password employee’s GitHub account to copy customer records
top_stories.summary: 1Password disclosed a security incident in which an attacker accessed a corporate GitHub account belonging to an employee and copied customer account records. The breach targeted a subset of customers, and 1Password, as an identity security and password management vendor, is directly relevant to the IAM space.

news.title: pCloud Password Manager Hit by Cyber Attack Involving Email Address Exposure and Login Attempts
news.summary: pCloud Pass, a cross-platform password manager, confirmed it was targeted by a cyber attack that resulted in exposure of user email addresses and unauthorized login attempts. A small number of pCloud Pass user accounts were affected, with users reporting unknown devices being connected to their accounts before the breach was contained.

news.title: pCloud confirms password manager hack after suspicious login alerts
news.summary: pCloud's password manager product, pCloud Pass, was hacked, resulting in unauthorized access to user accounts. The breach occurred despite users having two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled, with unknown devices connecting to affected accounts.

news.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
news.summary: A phishing campaign dubbed "GoodGuys" is actively targeting corporate users by impersonating major brands including Google, Nvidia, Accenture, and SpaceX to steal Google and Okta credentials. The attack vector uses fake invitations to paid expert interviews and webinars as lures to harvest identity credentials.

news.title: Google Cloud Requires AI Agents to Access Workspace Through Approved Methods
news.summary: Google Cloud is mandating that AI agents access Workspace services (Gmail, Google Drive, Docs) only through approved methods, specifically Workspace MCP servers or command line interface. This represents an access control and authorization policy change governing how AI agents are permitted to interact with enterprise productivity resources.

news.title: Recap of Microsoft Ignite 2026: Copilot as the Work OS and Agent Governance
news.summary: Microsoft Ignite 2026 featured announcements extending agent identity and governance capabilities across Azure, Foundry, Entra, and Defender. The event highlighted new agent identity and cost controls, with Microsoft Entra playing a role in governing AI agent access and permissions.

news.title: Google mandates MCP or CLI access for Workspace AI agents starting February 2027
news.summary: Google has announced security controls for Google Workspace and Google Cloud requiring MCP or CLI access for AI agents starting February 2027. The measures include dedicated agent identity controls to manage how autonomous AI agents authenticate and are authorized when accessing enterprise data and cloud infrastructure.

news.title: It's a Bot World. We're Just Living in It
news.summary: The article argues that bot detection has become ineffective and that security teams should apply equal privileged access controls to both human and machine identities. The piece frames machine identity and privileged access management (PAM) as critical controls in an environment where bots are increasingly indistinguishable from human users.

news.title: Credential Remediation Is Slow When You Don’t Know What Will Break
news.summary: GitGuardian's State of Secrets Sprawl 2026 report found that over 64% of valid secrets discovered in 2022 remained active as of January 2026, with teams stalling on remediation due to uncertainty about what revoking credentials would break. The report also highlights that validity-only triage methods miss 46% of critical secrets, recommending impact-based prioritization that considers what a credential can access and whether it was publicly exposed.

news.title: Com-Affiliated Hackers Hijack Cloud Accounts via Vishing for Data Theft and Extortion
news.summary: Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 has disclosed it is tracking multiple waves of vishing (voice phishing) attacks by Com-affiliated threat actors since August 2026, resulting in cloud account hijacking, data theft, and extortion. The attacks target organizations in financial services, healthcare, legal services, and construction sectors across the U.S., U.K., and Australia, with threat actors using social engineering to compromise cloud account credentials.

news.title: Secure agentic access to AWS with Enterprise-Managed Authorization
news.summary: AWS Sign-In is introducing Enterprise-Managed Authorization (EMA) using the Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG) to authorize AI agents accessing AWS MCP Server. The feature integrates with existing enterprise identity providers, extending OAuth-based authorization flows to agentic AI workloads within AWS environments.

news.title: What defenders need to know about ARTEX, the agentic AI framework threat actors abuse
news.summary: ARTEX, an AI-powered penetration testing framework, is being abused by multiple threat actor groups including Storm-0940, Storm-3358, and others to accelerate network reconnaissance and credential attacks. The framework's agentic AI capabilities are being leveraged to enhance workflows specifically targeting credential harvesting, which directly impacts IAM defenses.

news.title: Planning for 99.99 percent availability with the Amazon Cognito Plus feature plan
news.summary: Amazon Cognito has introduced a Plus feature plan designed to support 99.99% availability for sign-in and access control workloads. The plan covers managed user directories, enterprise federation, and passwordless authentication methods including passkeys and one-time passwords.

news.title: AWS IAM extends trusted identity propagation to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, and simplifies it in IAM Identity Center
news.summary: AWS has extended trusted identity propagation (TIP) to IAM federation and IAM Roles Anywhere, while also simplifying its implementation in IAM Identity Center. TIP enables the identity of human users or workloads to be carried with requests to supported AWS services, allowing it to be used in IAM policy conditions for access control and originating identity attribution.

news.title: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
news.summary: Broadcom has released patches addressing 23 vulnerabilities across VMware products including a critical authentication bypass flaw (CVE-2026-123903) rated 9.8 on the CVSS scale. The vulnerability resides in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) and could allow a malicious actor to bypass authentication controls.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Classic Flaw as Actor Targets Customer Secrets
news.summary: Norway's National Security Authority disclosed a vulnerability in Microsoft Azure API Management that an unknown threat actor exploited to target access tokens, secrets, and named values across multiple Norwegian businesses including energy companies. Microsoft has issued a fix for the classic flaw, which was actively used to harvest authentication credentials and sensitive configuration data.

news.title: New Inception extortion gang launches large-scale vishing campaign
news.summary: A new extortion group called 'Inception' has launched a large-scale vishing (voice phishing) campaign targeting single sign-on (SSO) credentials across multiple global organizations. The campaign focuses on harvesting SSO credentials as an entry point, making it directly relevant to IAM security practitioners.

news.title: Delegate user access to AI agents with Amazon Cognito token exchange
news.summary: Amazon Cognito is introducing token exchange functionality to enable delegated user access for AI agents using OAuth 2.0. The implementation allows applications to grant AI agents scoped permissions on behalf of authenticated users, extending identity federation patterns to agentic workflows.

news.title: New Inception Extortion Brand Tied to SSO Vishing Campaign
news.summary: A new extortion group called Inception has been linked to a vishing (voice phishing) campaign targeting employee SSO credentials, according to research from Okta and ReversingLabs. The campaign focuses on social engineering attacks to compromise single sign-on accounts, representing a direct threat to enterprise identity infrastructure.

news.title: ShinyHunters-linked crew resurfaces on new leak site
news.summary: Okta's threat intelligence team has discovered that a crew linked to the ShinyHunters leak site has resurfaced under the name "Inception" after the original site went dark in September. Okta tracks this group as O-UNC-053 and has identified it as a cluster that previously supplied victims to the ShinyHunters platform.

news.title: Know the identity behind the role: Authorize and audit with trusted identity propagation
news.summary: AWS has introduced trusted identity propagation, a new capability that makes it easier to grant access and audit activity based on the specific user or workload behind an IAM role. The feature allows organizations to authorize and audit at the individual identity level rather than at the role level, providing more granular visibility into who or what is performing actions within AWS environments.

news.title: CrowdStrike Makes AI Security Push With Blockbuster Zscaler Deal
news.summary: CrowdStrike is reportedly pursuing a $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler, combining endpoint protection with zero-trust network security. The deal would unite two major cybersecurity platforms, with a focus on securing AI agents through integrated zero-trust architecture.

news.title: How Security Vendors Are Tackling Access-Control Challenges for AI Agents
news.summary: Security vendors are developing converging approaches across identity, runtime, and development controls to address access-control challenges for AI agents in enterprise environments. Vendors' approaches to keeping AI agents within their assigned authorization boundaries vary, requiring CISOs to evaluate differing solutions.

news.title: Microsoft Debuts Offensive, Defensive Security Tools for the AI Era
news.summary: Microsoft announced AI agent security tools and transparency standards at its Ignite technical conference aimed at protecting enterprise systems. The announcement includes both offensive and defensive security tools oriented toward AI-era threats, though specific IAM-focused features were not detailed in the description.

news.title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
news.summary: Microsoft released a Patch Tuesday update addressing nearly 1,100 security vulnerabilities across Windows operating systems and supported software. The release includes fixes for 63 critical flaws, among them a zero-day vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook.
